misconceptions.name: 形容词放在 something 前
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“有趣的东西”，形容词放在前面。
misconceptions.move: 规则：形容词修饰 something、anything、nothing 时放在后面；全班读一读 something interesting。

misconceptions.name: 肯定句里用了 anything
misconceptions.why: 以为 something、anything 都是“某物”，可以随便换。
misconceptions.move: 对比：I saw something.（肯定）Did you see anything?（疑问）I didn't see anything.（否定）

misconceptions.name: 问频率用了 how long
misconceptions.why: 汉语“多久”既能问多长时间，也能问多久一次。
misconceptions.move: 看答语：Twice a week 是次数还是时长？说次数用 how often。

misconceptions.name: 看到次数就用 how many
misconceptions.why: 答语里有 twice，就以为问“几次”要用 how many。
misconceptions.move: 问：How many 后面缺了什么？对比 How many times a week…? 和 How often…?

misconceptions.name: 有 than 却用了原级
misconceptions.why: 汉语“比”字句里形容词不变：她比姐姐外向。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 than，问：两个人在比较，形容词要不要变成比较级？

misconceptions.name: 多音节形容词也加 -er
misconceptions.why: 把短词加 -er 的规则用到了长词上。
misconceptions.move: 拍手数音节：out-go-ing 三个音节，要在前面加 more。

misconceptions.name: more 和 -er 一起用
misconceptions.why: 记住了 more 表示“更”，又习惯性加了 -er。
misconceptions.move: 规则：比较级只变一次，要么加 -er，要么前面加 more。

misconceptions.name: 单音节词也用 most
misconceptions.why: 记住了 the most popular，就以为最高级都加 most。
misconceptions.move: 数音节：cheap 只有一个音节，直接加 -est。

misconceptions.name: 最高级前漏了 the
misconceptions.why: 汉语没有冠词，“城里最便宜的影院”前面不用加词。
misconceptions.move: 规则：最高级修饰名词时前面加 the；圈出 in our town，提示这是在一个范围里比。

misconceptions.name: most 和 -est 一起用
misconceptions.why: 记住了 most 表示“最”，又习惯性加了 -est。
misconceptions.move: 规则：最高级只变一次，要么加 -est，要么前面加 most。

misconceptions.name: enjoy 后接了 to do
misconceptions.why: 受 want to do、plan to do 影响，以为都接 to do。
misconceptions.move: 列两栏：plan、want、hope、expect + to do；enjoy + doing，让学生把 enjoy 放进对的一栏。

misconceptions.name: plan 后接了 doing
misconceptions.why: 受 enjoy doing、like watching 影响，以为都接 -ing。
misconceptions.move: 用同一张两栏表，让学生把 plan 放进对的一栏，再各造一句。

misconceptions.name: 两个动词直接连在一起
misconceptions.why: 汉语“打算看电影”两个动词直接连用，形式不变。
misconceptions.move: 问：第二个动词前要加 to 还是改成 -ing？先看第一个动词是谁。

misconceptions.name: going to 后直接接名词
misconceptions.why: 以为 is going to 已经包含“打算当”的意思，漏了动词 be。
misconceptions.move: 问：going to 后面要接动词原形，“当”用哪个动词？be。

misconceptions.name: going to 前漏了 be 动词
misconceptions.why: 把 going to 当成一个现成的词，忘了前面要随主语加 am/is/are。
misconceptions.move: 板书 I am / he is / they are going to…，让学生圈出 be。

misconceptions.name: 将来的“有”说成 will have
misconceptions.why: 汉语“将会有”直译成了 will have。
misconceptions.move: 先说现在时 There are robots.，再把 are 换成 will be。

misconceptions.name: will 后用了 is/are
misconceptions.why: 知道要用 be，却按名词单复数选了 is、are。
misconceptions.move: 规则：will 后永远用原形，is、am、are 的原形都是 be。

misconceptions.name: 不可数名词用了 how many
misconceptions.why: 牛奶能论杯、论瓶数，就以为它也能直接数。
misconceptions.move: 问：能说 one milk、two milks 吗？不能直接数的用 how much。

misconceptions.name: 可数名词用了 how much
misconceptions.why: 以为问“多少”都用 how much。
misconceptions.move: 问：能说 two bananas 吗？能数的用 how many + 复数名词。

misconceptions.name: I'd love to 漏了 to
misconceptions.why: 汉语“我很乐意”说完就结束，以为 I'd love 已经完整。
misconceptions.move: 补全原句：I'd love to (come). to 后省掉了动词，to 本身不能省。

misconceptions.name: if 从句也用了 will
misconceptions.why: 条件说的是将来的事，就在 if 句里也用 will。
misconceptions.move: 讲“主将从现”：划出 if 句和主句，分别标出时态再检查。

items.unit: Unit 1 Where did you go on vacation?
lessons: Where did you go on vacation
right: 形容词修饰 something 等不定代词时放在后面；
肯定句用 something：something interesting。

ladder.q: 用 something 或 anything 填空：There's ____ (new) on the blackboard.
用 something 或 anything 填空：I didn't buy ____ (special) for myself.
I have ____ ____ to do today.（我今天没什么特别的事要做。）

items.unit: Unit 2 How often do you exercise?
items.topic: 对 Twice a week 提问
right: Twice a week 说的是“多久一次”，问频率用 how often；
how long 问多长时间，答语像 For an hour.
typical: 汉语问“多久”，就用 how long：

ladder.q: —____ does he go to the movies? —Once a month.
—____ do you sleep every night? —About eight hours.
—How ____ times a week do you play tennis? —Three times.

items.unit: Unit 3 I'm more outgoing than my sister.
right: 有 than，要用比较级；
outgoing 是多音节词，前面加 more：more outgoing。
typical: Tina is outgoinger than her sister.

ladder.q: Tom is ____ (tall) than Sam.
This book is ____ (interesting) than that one.
I'm ____ (good) at math than my brother, but he's ____ (funny).

items.unit: Unit 4 What's the best movie theater?
items.stem: This is ____ movie theater in our town.
right: cheap 是单音节词，最高级加 -est；
最高级修饰名词，前面要加 the：the cheapest。
typical: 最高级就是在前面加 the most：

ladder.q: This is ____ (big) shop in our town.
Which is ____ (good) movie theater near here?
Of all the students, Mike is ____ (funny).

items.unit: Unit 5 Do you want to watch a game show?
lessons: want to watch a game show
items.stem: Jack plans ____ a movie tonight. He enjoys ____ action movies.
right: plan 后接 to do：plans to watch；
enjoy 后接 doing：enjoys watching。
typical: 两个空都跟 plan 一样用 to do：

ladder.q: I hope ____ (see) you again.
My parents enjoy ____ (watch) the news after dinner.
She enjoys ____ (read), and she wants ____ (learn) French.

items.unit: Unit 6 I'm going to study computer science.
items.stem: “他长大后打算当医生。”He ____ a doctor when he grows up.
right: be going to + 动词原形；“当”要用 be：
He is going to be a doctor.
typical: He is going to a doctor.

ladder.q: 用 be going to 填空：I ____ (visit) my grandparents this weekend.
—What ____ you going to ____ when you grow up? —An engineer.
改成一般疑问句：They're going to be teachers.
ladder.a: Are they going to be teachers?

items.stem: “将来会有更多的机器人。”哪句对？
right: there be 的将来时是 there will be，
will 后用原形 be：There will be more robots.

ladder.q: There ____ ____ a test tomorrow.
—____ there be robots in every home? —Yes, there will.
People ____ (have) robots at home in 50 years.

items.unit: Unit 8 How do you make a banana milk shake?
items.stem: ____ bananas and ____ milk do we need?
right: bananas 可数，用 how many；
milk 不可数，用 how much。
typical: 牛奶也能一杯一杯地数：
How many bananas and how many milk…?

ladder.q: ____ yogurt do we need?
____ apples do you want?
____ cups of milk do we need?

items.unit: Unit 9 Can you come to my party?
lessons: Can you come to my party
items.stem: 朋友邀请小明，小明这样回答。你同意吗？
work: —Can you come to my birthday party this Friday?
right: I'd love to. 是 I'd love to come. 的省略，
to 不能省：Sure, I'd love to.

ladder.q: —Would you like to go hiking? —Yes, I'd like ____.
—Can you go to the movies with us? —I'd love ____, but I have to study.
—Can you help me with my English? —I'd be glad ____.

items.unit: Unit 10 If you go to the party, you'll have a great time!
lessons: If you go to the party
items.stem: 用 if 把 It will rain tomorrow. 和 We will stay at home. 连成一句。小明从第几步开始错？
work: “明天下雨”是条件，用 if 引出
从句照搬原句：If it will rain tomorrow,
主句用一般将来时：we will stay at home.
合起来：If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
right: if 条件句“主将从现”：if 句用一般现在时，
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

ladder.q: If you ____ (study) hard, you'll pass the test.
If it ____ (be) sunny tomorrow, we ____ (go) hiking.
If she ____ (not get) up early, she ____ (miss) the bus.
